这一次，我们同时向真人实拍短片和动画AI技术短片开放招募，两类创作并行不悖、不设: This time, we are simultaneously opening recruitment to both live-action short films and animated AI technology short films, with the two types of creation proceeding in parallel without conflict or hierarchical distinction.
我们不想急着给未来下定论，不去预设真人创作和AI创作谁高谁低、谁输谁赢，而是搭建: We don't want to hastily pass judgment on the future, nor do we wish to presuppose whether human creation or AI creation is superior or inferior, who wins or loses. Rather, we are building a platform where young creators proficient in different creative approaches can collide, experiment, make mistakes, and grow freely.
我们始终相信，真人创作与AI创作不是敌人，而是并行探索、互补共生的两条创作路径: We have always believed that human creation and AI creation are not adversaries, but rather two parallel paths of creative exploration that complement and coexist with each other.
